A1.justification: Both PDFs describe VGGRPO and contain readable main text and Appendices A–B. Textual and visual inspection supports reliable matching of equations, experiments, figures, and tables despite changed pagination.

before.justification: v1 reports original video-generation experiments, ablations, efficiency measurements, and robustness analyses in Section 4 and Appendix B.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including Tables 1–3 and the latent-perturbation analysis in Figure 5.

M1.justification: The latent geometry model, stitching procedure, two geometric rewards, GRPO objective, and test-time guidance are unchanged in Section 3 and Appendix B.2.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same generated-video and DL3DV, RealEstate10K, and MiraData training coverage, static and dynamic evaluation scenarios, standard VBench captions, and latent-perturbation scenarios.

E2.justification: Tables 1 and 3 retain the same Base, SFT, Epipolar-DPO, and VideoGPA comparators. Geometry-model and RGB-versus-latent comparisons also match. Newly cited World-R1 is not added to the evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: The backbones, training settings, metrics, and evaluation procedures are unchanged. Both versions retain 190 static and 200 dynamic captions, 50 RealEstate10K perturbation-test sequences, and the same test-time guidance schedule.

E4.justification: Section 4.3 and Appendix B retain the same geometry-backbone and reward-component ablations, guidance and efficiency studies, qualitative examples, and latent-noise robustness analysis in Figure 5.

E5.justification: Both versions use the same point-estimate reporting in Tables 1–3 and Figure 5. Neither provides evaluation run or seed counts, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–3 and the plotted and qualitative findings are unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains Wan2.2-5B VGGRPO static VQ/MQ scores of 62.63/68.42 and epipolar error of 0.093.

T1.justification: Equations 1–32 and their mathematical explanations are retained, including Appendix A's flow formulation, ODE-to-SDE conversion, and closed-form KL derivation. Changes in equation placement do not alter the mathematics.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution statements, and conclusion retain the same claims about latent-space geometric rewards, dynamic-scene support, improved consistency and camera smoothness, and avoiding repeated RGB decoding.

C2.justification: Interpretations of reward complementarity, latent robustness, preserved generalization, and lower Dynamic Degree from smoother camera motion are unchanged. No substantive limitations or applicability qualifications are added or removed.

D1.justification: Sections 4.1 and B.1 retain identical optimizer, LoRA, connector, and training-cost details, including approximately 1536 GPU hours. Algorithm 1 and the project-page access information also remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Sections 1–2 add citations to Cosmos 3, pi0.7, IR3D-Bench, Fast-WAM, JOVA, Wonderland, and World-R1, without substantive new discussion or revised novelty claims. Genie 3 remains the same cited work despite revised attribution.

P1.justification: Date/version text and citation labels are updated, and references expand author names and bibliographic identifiers. The substantive prose, section order, and appendix narrative remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Added citations and longer references alter line wrapping and page breaks; for example, Equation 1 moves from page 5 to page 6. Figures 1–5 and Tables 1–3 retain their content, styling, and captions.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly improves scholarly documentation by acknowledging additional relevant work, including World-R1, and supplying explicit identifiers for previously less detailed references. These improve coverage and source traceability; the scientific methods, evidence, interpretations, and appendices remain unchanged.
